fml.menu.mods.info.description.climbingc: Utility mod that adds hand-held Climbing Claws for wall and ceiling traversal, with enchantments and survival-friendly mobility.
jei.climbingclaws.climbing_claws:
Equip the claws in either hand and hold right-click to raise them like a shield, or equip them in a Curios hands slot when Curios is installed.
Climb solid walls and undersides while the claws are active.
Stop pressing movement to hang in place, or hold sneak to climb back down.
Climbing uses durability. Unbreaking and Mending help, and Efficiency increases climb speed.
Wall Spring lets you press jump while climbing to burst upward. Level II launches farther.
Canopy Grip lets the claws latch onto partial surfaces like leaves.
In your main hand, the claws also work as a light weapon and support Sharpness and Fire Aspect.
